Thanks for reaching out—great to hear you're interested in Aether.

We built this because job searching is exhausting. Aether sources roles from licensed job APIs (nothing older than 30 days), then shows you *why* each role actually fits through deterministic scoring. Your resume tailoring and cover letters stay grounded in your real history—we have an anti-fabrication guard that prevents any claim you can't back up.

Every application waits in your approval queue before sending. You're always in control.

On pricing: we offer a free plan (A$0, 5 agent runs/month, no card needed) so you can test it. If you want more, Starter is A$19/month, Pro is A$39/month or A$359/year, and Power is A$69/month.

Founder Vikram built this for his own search, so it's shaped by real frustration with existing tools.

Start free here: https://5cb5f0620.abacusai.cloud

Happy to answer any other questions.
